experiment: Reuse free-variable scope storage across queries
hypothesis: Retaining scope-array capacity removes per-query slice and regrowth allocation while preserving independently owned capture results.
correctness_counterexamples: Successive queries with different parameter names
Captured results retained across later queries
Nested loops, matches and labeled/optional lambda binders
Enclosing locals that shadow global functions

interpretation: The comparison is a pure compiler implementation change: every generated target is byte-identical across compilers, temperatures and rounds. Heap-pointer, linear capacity and RSS are distinct metrics. Wall-time spread and the A/A control limit the precision of timing claims.
